info.name: Message API integration tests
info.description: End-to-end smoke tests replayed by newman in CI (MAIR-117). `baseUrl` is injected by docker-compose-integration.yml; the default in environment.json targets a local stack. The API only holds Core's public key (MAIR-680): integration_test.sh signs the EdDSA JWTs of the seeded Admin (user 1) and plain users 2 and 3 (init-test.sql) with the run's key and passes them with --env-var; the pre-request script only forges an HS256 token that must be refused. The scenario creates a chat, exchanges and edits messages from both users, manages participants, then deletes the chat, so it is replayable against a persistent database. The SSE stream is only checked unauthenticated.

exec: // MAIR-680: the API only holds Core's public key. The EdDSA tokens (jwt_admin, jwt_agent, jwt_third,
// jwt_forged, jwt_expired) are signed by integration_test.sh with the run's key and passed with
// --env-var (the Postman sandbox cannot sign EdDSA). This script only forges jwt_hs256: an HS256
// token for the Admin signed with a random secret, which the API must refuse whatever the secret.
// OpenAPI contract (MAIR-262), identical in every API collection: the spec served by the API
// under test is loaded once per run, every response is then checked against it (collection test
// script) and the last request fails when an operation or a documented status was never tested.
throw new Error(`OpenAPI spec unavailable (${err || res.code}): the stack must set SWAGGER_ENABLED=true`);
// OpenAPI contract (MAIR-262), identical in every API collection: the answer of every request
// must be documented by the spec of the API under test (operation, status, content type, body
// schema), and the (operation, status) pair is recorded for the coverage check of the last request.
// The operation of `method path`, literal segments winning over path parameters
return candidates.length ? { template: candidates[0], operation: spec.paths[candidates[0]][method] } : null;
// JSON schema keywords the validator understands; `$ref`s are inlined, the rest (`format`,
// `example`, `description`...) is dropped so unknown formats such as `int64` never fail.
return openapi.clean(spec, schema.$ref.split('/').slice(1).reduce((node, key) => node[key], spec), depth + 1);
if (typeof schema.additionalProperties === 'object') out.additionalProperties = openapi.clean(spec, schema.additionalProperties, depth + 1);
['oneOf', 'anyOf', 'allOf'].filter((key) => schema[key]).forEach((key) => { out[key] = schema[key].map((s) => openapi.clean(spec, s, depth + 1)); });
// Checks one answer against the spec and records the (operation, status) pair.
check: (spec, method, path, code, contentType, text) => {
pm.test(`Contract: ${code} body matches the schema of ${method.toUpperCase()} ${found.template}`, () => {
const matches = (o) => { const before = errors.length; validate(value, o, at); const ok = errors.length === before; errors.length = before; return ok; };
if (s.oneOf && s.oneOf.filter(matches).length !== 1) errors.push(`${at}: does not match exactly one oneOf`);
const typeOf = value === null ? 'null' : Array.isArray(value) ? 'array' : typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) ? 'integer' : typeof value;
if (types && !types.includes(typeOf) && !(typeOf === 'integer' && types.includes('number'))) { errors.push(`${at}: ${typeOf} instead of ${types.join('|')}`); return; }
if (s.enum && !s.enum.some((e) => JSON.stringify(e) === JSON.stringify(value))) errors.push(`${at}: ${JSON.stringify(value)} not in ${JSON.stringify(s.enum)}`);
if (s.const !== undefined && JSON.stringify(s.const) !== JSON.stringify(value)) errors.push(`${at}: not ${JSON.stringify(s.const)}`);
if (s.minLength !== undefined && value.length < s.minLength) errors.push(`${at}: shorter than ${s.minLength}`);
if (s.maxLength !== undefined && value.length > s.maxLength) errors.push(`${at}: longer than ${s.maxLength}`);
if (s.pattern && !new RegExp(s.pattern, 'u').test(value)) errors.push(`${at}: does not match ${s.pattern}`);
if (s.minItems !== undefined && value.length < s.minItems) errors.push(`${at}: fewer than ${s.minItems} items`);
if (s.maxItems !== undefined && value.length > s.maxItems) errors.push(`${at}: more than ${s.maxItems} items`);
// A request may opt out with `pm.variables.set('openapi_contract', 'skip')` in its pre-request
// script, saying why (API_template checks its JWT gate on an undocumented scope).

exec: // OpenAPI coverage (MAIR-262), last request of the collection: every documented operation has
// at least one success case, and each documented 400/401/403/404/409/412 has a case of its own.
// 429, 500, 502 and 503 cannot be produced on purpose on a healthy stack: the handler tests
// (`cargo test`) cover them. Any other gap is listed in the collection variable
// case); an exception that is covered or no longer documented fails too, so it never goes stale.
required.push({ key: `${op} 2xx`, covered: statuses.some((s) => s.startsWith('2') && covered.includes(`${op} ${s}`)) });
const missing = required.filter((r) => !r.covered && !(r.key in exceptions)).map((r) => r.key);
